newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Sept 25.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Sept 25.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
* The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$15.92 (+0.10)

BHP said at Tuesday's annual meeting it still saw profitable opportunities in the copper industry despite its first quarter loss from the Magma Copper operation. Overnight copper prices jumped back over the key US$1,900 a tonne level

Copper prices rose US$37 to US$1,920 a tonne on the London Metals Exchange, boosted by a larger-than-expected fall in warehouse stocks of 8,825 tonnes. December Comex copper closed 1.50 cents higher at 89.15 per pound.
Applied Microbiology Inc said on Tuesday it has signed a non-binding letter of intent to sell its food preservative unit to Burns Philp & Co Ltd for $13.5 million in cash and a $2.5 million loan.

Blue Circle Industries Plc and Lend Lease Corporation said on Tuesday night they had agreed to form a joint venture to plan and develop surplus land holdings in BCI's UK land bank. The venture will initially focus on Kent, looking in particular at 2,250 acres in the northwest of the county, which is in southeast England.

MIM Holdings Ltd said late on Tuesday its Mount Isa copper operations in central Queensland had a potential mine life of at least 15 years. The company said this estimate was based on reserves of 66 million tonnes and 60 million tonnes of resources from the operations and the nearby Enterprise orebody.
